services.desc: Imagine exchanging vows on the deck of a century-old steamship as the sun sets over Lake of Bays. Or hosting your team aboard a vessel that embodies Canadian craftsmanship and history. The SS Bigwin offers a truly unique venue for life's most important moments - intimate, elegant, and unlike anything else in Muskoka. Exchange vows on the water - or celebrate with your wedding party aboard a historic steamship. An intimate, unforgettable setting for up to 30 guests. Step away from the boardroom and onto the water. blurb: Guests join a 90-minute guided cruise aboard the SS Bigwin, a beautifully restored 1910 steamship. Cruises depart from Dorset or Dwight and glide through Trading Bay, past century-old lodges and the pristine Muskoka shoreline. The experience includes narrated heritage cruises and options for private charters and sunset cruises.
extraNote: Depart from Dorset or Dwight · June – October 2026
